headings.text: How to Practice English Alone at Home (No Partner Needed)

paragraphs: No one to talk to? No problem. Six solo methods — from shadowing to teaching an imaginary class — that work.
You do not need a partner to improve. Solitude is an advantage.
Echo English audio immediately. Trains rhythm without a partner.
Explain a topic to an empty chair. "Today we learn tenses." Teaching forces clear speech.
Narrate tasks aloud: "Now I am washing clothes." Builds automatic sentences.
Pick a news paragraph. Read with feeling. Records show reading aloud boosts fluency.
The app gives prompts, you answer, it scores. Real feedback, zero judgement.
Speak to your reflection. Watch mouth shape. Fix "th", "v", "w".
20 min daily split across these. In a month, alone time becomes your best class.
The only missing ingredient is starting.
Free browser-based English speaking practice. No downloads, no sign-ups, no data leaving your computer.
